profile.headline: Software Engineer at Stripe
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a graph execution SDK and service template to facilitate the migration of a monolithic recommendation service to a microservice architecture, enabling 8+ atomic teams to deploy their own Spring Boot services
• Led 4 engineers to create 3 full stack React/Spring Boot tools used to manage, orchestrate, configure, visualize, and debug graph-based recommendation strategies, improving A/B testing and developer velocity by 250%
• Mentored and trained a co-op and intern, scoped and designed their projects, and played a key role in their professional development, resulting in a successful transition into a full-time role

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led the re-platforming of the content recommendations service, migrating it from a black box Python Flask service to a graph-based Java Dropwizard service, resulting in improved traceability and transparency
• Improved system performance by implementing concurrency, caching, and algorithm optimizations, resulting in a 400% reduction in API response times and a 200% increase in throughput for batch email builds
• Owned the migration roadmap and end-to-end development process from design to testing to productionisation in collaboration with cross-functional teams and assigned roadmap tasks to fellow engineers
• Refactored monolith into 3 gRPC microservices to host vector-based personalization and Bayesian machine learning models, scaled to support 34+ million customers per hour in burst batch email traffic
• Created and maintained Jenkins and Airflow jobs to efficiently process reinforcement learning Hive data

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented various merging and filtering logic for the recommendation service used to generate real-time personalized email content for customers, resulting in millions in increased annual gross revenue
• Created 5 React-based admin tools written in JavaScript with a PHP backend to streamline recommendation algorithm configuration and testing for cross-functional teams in engineering, data science, and marketing
• Mentored 6 junior engineers and reviewed their React code as the sole approved JavaScript reviewer on the team

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a Microsoft Visual Basic tool to populate and filter spreadsheets using SQL queries
• Designed a template for a weekly newsletter and scripted a JavaScript email scraper to populate its content
• Created wireframes to reorganize and redesign the company’s home page in cooperation with the UX/UI team

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Explained the fundamentals of C++ during lab and office hours for course, COMP11: Intro to Computer Science
• Provided constructive feedback on students’ projects by critiquing functionality, style, readability, runtime efficiency, and modularity
